A '''bio-plasmatic gel launcher''' was designed by the [[Qektoth Confederation]]. It was used to launch [[bio-plasmatic gel torpedo]]es, and was mounted on [[Qektoth attack cruiser|Qektoth Attack Cruiser]]s.
